items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. Sections 4.3(d)–(f) also exclude personal belongings and property in a vehicle or away from the insured location, so nothing is payable.
Sections 4.3(e) and 5.2.5 exclude the car and vehicle-related expenses. No insured building damage or covered debris transport is involved, so nothing is payable.
